actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Chrome DevTools CLI page-scoped commands were invoked without the required explicit LinkedIn page target, so the CLI rejected or misrouted the probe.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Resolve and select the LinkedIn page first, then pass its page id explicitly to every page-scoped snapshot, console, network and evaluate call; any targeting error fails closed.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: The Extensions DevTools API can lack a browser context even while the unpacked extension service worker and injected DOM are alive, making list_extensions an unreliable release signal.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Never use list_extensions as a release gate; triangulate extension service-worker identity, manifest/storage runtime health and Powerhouse DOM output instead.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Chrome content scripts execute in an isolated world, so page-world window sentinels can be absent while the extension is actually active.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Do not use page-world globals as primary evidence; verify the extension service worker, live storage health and injected DOM overlays.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Candidate commands can reach a default or different Chrome DevTools daemon when the candidate session is not explicitly pinned end to end.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Use one dedicated candidate session and profile, pass the same session id through installer, wrapper, monitor and gates, and verify runtime identity before accepting evidence.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Chrome DevTools CLI session identifiers accept a constrained hex/hyphen format; human-readable identifiers outside that format are rejected.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Validate session identifiers before daemon startup and use the canonical valid candidate id ca11da7e unless a governed replacement is introduced.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: macOS LaunchAgents do not inherit the interactive shell npm-global PATH, so a wrapper that invokes bare chrome-devtools can fail with command not found.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Resolve chrome-devtools with command -v during installation, validate it exists, and pin that absolute executable path in the generated LaunchAgent wrapper.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: macOS LaunchAgent PATH differs from the interactive shell, so relying on a bare node executable can make scheduled browser evidence fail while manual commands work.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Resolve and validate the absolute Node executable or its containing directory during installation and inject it explicitly into the LaunchAgent runtime environment.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Operator copy-paste can place Markdown link syntax or whitespace into webhook environment values when installers accept unvalidated strings.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Accept only plain validated Make HTTPS webhook URLs and fail installation immediately on Markdown or whitespace contamination.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: chrome.storage calls can throw synchronously after an extension context is invalidated, so attaching only a Promise catch does not intercept the failure.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Wrap Chrome API invocation itself in try/catch, also handle Promise rejection, and stop persistence/timers from invalidated extension instances.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Package or folder labels can advance while manifest.json remains on an older runtime version, creating false release identity and misleading verification.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Treat manifest.json as the canonical release identity and derive monitor, candidate and visible runtime version checks from that manifest value.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Modern official Chrome no longer provides reliable unpacked-extension loading through the historical --load-extension command-line assumption.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Install the candidate extension through the supported Chrome DevTools extension API and prove it through live service-worker and runtime evidence rather than command-line flags.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Earlier runtime gates could continue to PASS after CLI, evaluation or target-selection errors, converting missing evidence into false green.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Classify every CLI, protocol, evaluation or mandatory-signal failure as non-PASS and require grounded runtime triangulation before release acceptance.

actionableFailureKnowledge.rootCause: Diagnostics that navigate to extension or worker URLs can create visible tabs and interfere with the user's browser while trying to inspect background execution.
actionableFailureKnowledge.fix: Target extension service workers directly through the DevTools service-worker context and regression-block any automatic visible worker-tab creation.
